label:
Medicated ghee
(ghrita)
step: cook with herb paste and water
note: Murcchana (a first cooking of the ghee with herbs) and Shata-dhauta (washing the ghee 100 times in water) are pre-treatments claimed to raise quality and keeping time.

about.text: Ghee cooked slowly with a herb paste and water or a decoction, then strained, as a classical Ayurvedic preparation. The ghee carries fat-soluble herb compounds and is taken as medicine, not food.

how.text: Liquids other than water can serve as drava: herb juice, decoction, cow milk or cow urine (IJCPR Sneha Kalpana review).

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: 1 part herb paste (kalka), 4 parts ghee (sneha) and 16 parts water or decoction (drava).
On a mild to moderate flame, no temperature given, until a wick rolled from the paste burns without crackling and the froth has gone (sneha siddhi).

facts.v: Ghee washed with water 100 times, 5–8 min each, in a copper vessel
